Mass 1.132 +/- 0.051 solar masses from Wang et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-32 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...82W/abstract). entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,001 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff3f0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,001 K and log g 4.22 (u1 0.413, u2 0.287): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
